eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Whether the programme was satisfactorily completed, whether the conditions of probation were complied with, and whether any subsection (f) bar applies are the participant's own statements of fact, each checked by the participant against a document they obtain. Whether the prosecuting attorney objects, and how the court finds on any alleged probation violation, are never predicted.
eligibilityData.supportingDocumentNote: Every document named here is participant-obtained. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect any of them, and no drafted document characterises what any of them says.
additionalFacts: We have requested your Division of Motor Vehicles certification on your behalf and it confirms completion.
The clerk has sent us your dismissal order and the probation office confirmed your expiry date to us.
Because one year has run since your dismissal on 10/01/2023, you are eligible and the court must grant the petition.
This is the same as an acquittal or a dismissal after pretrial diversion, and the record will be sealed and destroyed.
Your driving record will be cleared at the same time and you will never have to disclose this anywhere.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label is set by presentation.movantRole in the config, not by the fixture key name; the word petitioner is prohibited in rendered output.
identityFieldNote: caseData.docketNumber holds the participant's own case number and caseData.countyName their own county; both are required screening answers and are deliberately left blank in the fixtures under the artifact convention. The rendered document cannot go out without them; they are supplied by the participant, never by LegalEase. caseData.court is left blank because no source read for this track states the court level — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal.
expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA. (1) Prohibited terms: 'petition', 'acquittal', 'pretrial diversion', 'sealed' and 'destroyed'. (2) It asserts that LegalEase obtained documents on the participant's behalf and that agencies reported to LegalEase. LegalEase does not contact the Division of Motor Vehicles, the clerk or the probation office, does not obtain, receive or inspect any of the four documents, and never characterises what any of them says — the entire point of this component is that the participant collects them. (3) It computes the one-year period from the dismissal date, when subsection (g)(1) runs it from the expiration of the term of probation, and then asserts eligibility and predicts that the court must grant. (4) It promises that the driving record will be cleared, when § 17C-5-2b(g)(1) excepts Division of Motor Vehicles records on its face and § 61-11-25(a) independently provides that no DMV record may be expunged by virtue of any order under this section — and a participant whose goal is the driving record is a self-help stop condition. (5) It promises the participant never has to disclose the record anywhere, which is on the committed state pack's own never-say list and ignores the express exception for inquiries made in connection with a subsequent offence under § 17C-5-2. (6) It proceeds while priorFelonyConviction, every subsection (f) answer, priorDeferral and probationViolations are all answered against the participant. (a) It fills court identity no source supplies: a circuit-court name, a county, a case number, an OTN, a judge, a prosecutor and a filing date, none of which LegalEase may prefill — the compiled profile records West Virginia courts as circuit, magistrate or municipal and no source read for this track says which hears a § 17C-5-2b matter. (b) It populates protected fields — date of birth, SSN last four, state ID, driver's licence number, FBI number and a fingerprint identifier — which must stay blank. (c) It asserts outside-party acts no source states: that the Division of Motor Vehicles confirmed completion directly to LegalEase, and that the prosecuting attorney was served and does not object. Service is the participant's own act, attested by the participant, and no prosecutor position is ever stated. (d) It asserts a hearing outcome and predicts that the court will grant. (e) It states an eligibilityBasisLabel asserting confirmed eligibility when no eligibility conclusion may be asserted on this track. (f) It states a fee amount and a waiver: § 17C-5-2b charges no fee for either motion, subsection (h) court costs are stated nowhere as an amount, the registry records the fee waiver as 'none stated in § 17C-5-2b', and the $100 State Police processing fee belongs to the § 61-11-26 conviction route.
